remarks: Located in Stamford's vibrant Mid City neighborhood, 13 Dolsen Pl offers easy access to shopping, dining, parks, transportation, houses of worship, and more - putting convenience at your doorstep. Set on a quiet residential street, the two-story layout provides great flow for both daily living and entertaining. The main level features an open living and dining area filled with natural light, while the kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers privacy with its own full bath, complemented by a second bedroom and additional full bath. Practical amenities include gas heat, central air, an in-unit washer/dryer, and private parking. A smart option for those seeking comfort and accessibility in the heart of Stamford. Please note: photos shown are of a similar unit. All square footage is approximate; please measure if exact dimensions are needed.
